entries.note: Portrait filters: the depth-driven blur exists (springboard/render/src/depth_blur.rs, depth_blur::tests). The portrait lighting kernels are missing, and the depth or matte input comes from the caller. role inferred from the owning path; the metallib was not disassembled
entries.ready_note: Shader pass: portrait relighting from depth (Lambert model in springboard/render/src/portrait_lighting.rs, relight); not the reference curves.

entries.name: RawCamera.metallib
entries.role: Computer-vision, computational photography or ML image processing shaders
entries.note: A CPU Bayer demosaic with white balance and a RAW parameter model exist; the Apple RAW processor's full pipeline and its shader are not reproduced.
entries.ready_note: Shader pass: bilinear Bayer demosaic (springboard/render/src/bayer.rs, demosaic_bilinear); the full RAW pipeline is not reproduced.

entries.name: Photogrammetry_Matching_Kernels.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: BifrOSt has 3D models (springboard/ui/src/scene3d.rs, scene_material.rs, mesh.rs, particle_system3d.rs) that draw nothing, and no 3D rasteriser or PBR shader; needed for 3D previews (Quick Look USD) and any 3D app. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled. Shader pass: open. The job is feature detection and descriptor matching for photogrammetry, a multi-stage pipeline with no detector yet.

entries.name: ProcessAccelerate.metallib
entries.role: Computer-vision, computational photography or ML image processing shaders
entries.note: BifrOSt has no on-device vision/ML image pipeline (only CPU guided filter, histogram and subject-lift models); needed for Photos edits, portrait/depth effects and image analysis. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled. Shader pass: open. The encoder preprocessing kernels are not identified from the row, so there is no job to implement yet.
